releases.title: Reel Men in Cape Town (Remix)
releases.description: The TAKüRA Remix of the ZÜVA original. It began with one line a friend sang on a fishing trip in South Africa. Now it is Afro House at 122 BPM: a female lead sings the “We’re the reel men in Cape Town” hook over a “Cape Town” call and response. Released 20 November 2026.

releases.title: Dzoka
releases.description: Dzoka means “come back” in Shona. Peak-time Afro House at 123 BPM: a soulful female vocal calls “Dzoka, dzoka kwandiri” (come back to me) over a hypnotic four-bar motif, rolling congas and deep sub, with crowd chants built for sunrise sets. The fourth TAKüRA single, released 23 October 2026.

releases.title: Moto (Fire)
releases.description: Moto means fire in Shona, and it is the name behind the label itself, making this one the heart of the project. The third TAKüRA single: Afro House with Shona vocals, released 3 July 2026.

releases.title: Nditore
releases.description: Shona for “take me.” Deep, melodic Afro House about loneliness and longing in a city you don’t belong to. Mbira textures, sub bass, and vocal lines that switch between Shona and English.

releases.title: Kumba
releases.description: A deep Afro House groove built from the sonic memory of Zimbabwe. Mbira-inflected melodies, driving soulful percussion, and a dancefloor made for open skies.
